title: Maximization of the efficiency of the first Dirichlet eigenfunction and improved eigenvalue inequalities
summary: We study the efficiency of the first Dirichlet eigenfunction $u$ on bounded convex domains $Ω\subset \mathbb{R}^N$, defined as the ratio between the mean value of $u$ on $Ω$ and its maximum value. By exploiting improved log-concavity estimates, we establish new sharp lower bounds for the first eigenvalue $λ_1$ and upper bounds for the efficiency in terms of the geometry of the domain, refining classical inequalities by Payne, Stakgold, and Hersch.
